translations.web: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.
translations.bsb: Each year you and your household are to eat it before the LORD your God in the place the LORD will choose.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
translations.asv: Thou shalt eat it before Jehovah thy God year by year in the place which Jehovah shall choose, thou and thy household.
